 On the 3rd at Suwon KT Wiz Park, Game 1 of the 2026 Shinhan SOL KBO Korean Series between KT Wiz and Samsung Lions was held.
 It is a matchup between KT, which is aiming for a combined championship for the first time in five years since the 2021 season's combined title, and Samsung, which returned to the Korean Series stage for the first time in two years since the 2024 season. On this day, KT started Daniel, and Samsung started Choi Won-tae.
 In the top of the eighth, KT pitcher Park Yeong-hyeon is pitching valiantly. 2026.11.03
